title: A Cascaded Framework with a Cross-Attention-Guided Mamba-CNN Model for Pre- and Post-Treatment Glioma Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29792v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate glioma segmentation is vital for diagnosis and follow-up, but manual segmentation is time-consuming, subjective, and variable across interpreters. Gliomas are heterogeneous in size, shape, and location. Deep learning has therefore emerged as a potential solution. CNNs excel at local features but may struggle with long-range dependencies, whereas Vision Transformers capture global context efficiently but incur higher computational complexity. Most previous studies focused on pre-treatment gliomas; post-treatment cases with resection cavities (RCs) remain less explored. This study proposes a Cross-Attention-Guided Mamba-CNN (CMC-Seg) model within a cascaded framework for pre- and post-treatment diffuse glioma segmentation, aiming to balance accuracy and computational cost. translated_title: 一种用于治疗前和治疗后胶质瘤分割的级联框架与交叉注意力引导的Mamba-CNN模型
translated_abstract: 胶质瘤的精确分割对诊断和随访至关重要，但人工分割耗时、主观且不同解读者之间存在差异。胶质瘤在大小、形状和位置上具有异质性，因此深度学习成为一种潜在的解决方案。卷积神经网络（CNN）擅长提取局部特征，但在处理长程依赖关系时可能存在困难；而视觉Transformer能够高效捕捉全局上下文，但计算复杂度更高。以往大多数研究集中于治疗前胶质瘤；对于带有切除腔（RCs）的治疗后病例，相关研究仍然较少。本研究提出了一种在级联框架下的交叉注意力引导的Mamba-CNN（CMC-Seg）模型，用于治疗前和治疗后的弥漫性胶质瘤分割，旨在平衡准确性和计算成本。实验使用了弥漫性胶质瘤患者的BraTS 2025多参数磁共振成像（mpMRI）数据。经过预处理后，粗分割模型提取以肿瘤为中心的图像块，这些图像块随后被……
tldr: 本研究提出了一种级联框架下的交叉注意力引导Mamba-CNN模型（CMC-Seg），用于治疗前和治疗后的弥漫性胶质瘤分割，在保证精度的同时平衡了计算成本。
